name: Leadership
summary: Setting direction, creating clarity, and helping others move without relying on title.

name: Ownership
summary: Taking responsibility for outcomes, gaps, and follow-through beyond the easiest boundary.

name: Collaboration
summary: Working productively with teammates who bring different context, skills, or working styles.

name: Conflict & Influence
summary: Navigating disagreement and building commitment through evidence, listening, and tradeoffs.

name: Ambiguity
summary: Making responsible progress when requirements, data, or ownership are incomplete.

name: Failure & Growth
summary: Owning a miss, learning specifically, and changing later behavior.

name: Execution & Prioritization
summary: Choosing what matters, managing constraints, and delivering with appropriate quality.

name: Mentorship
summary: Helping another person grow through context, feedback, and increasing independence.

name: Technical Judgment
summary: Making engineering decisions under real constraints and revisiting them when evidence changes.

name: Customer Impact
summary: Connecting technical work to a concrete user need while protecting trust and quality.

name: Cross-functional Work
summary: Aligning engineering choices with partners who own different goals and vocabulary.

name: Incident & Quality
summary: Responding calmly to failures and improving the system rather than assigning blame.
